comparisons.name: sobel_quantize_320x240

baseline.label: Std build
baseline.checksum_policy: FNV-style checksum over quantized bin and magnitude scaled by 1000
baseline.timer_boundary: computeSobelQuantizedCandidate, Sobel max-channel selection plus magnitude/angle quantize for inner pixels
baseline.gate: organized pcl::RGB image, width>=3, height>=3, borders are zero-filled
baseline.mask: magnitude_threshold predicate; border pixels excluded from timed inner-pixel rows
baseline.reduction: no cross-lane reduction; scalar Sobel staging and RVV per-lane sqrt/atan2/angle quantize
baseline.asm_boundary: computeSobelQuantizedCandidate / inlined RVV math in bench_cgm_rvv
